programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In NIGERIA!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Nigeria for the first time, experiencing one of Africa’s most vibrant and energetic cultures while celebrating his birthday. From exploring the streets and connecting with locals to taking in the music, food, and atmosphere, Speed turns the trip into a full celebration. Blending culture, chaos, and personal moments, the episode captures an unforgettable birthday experience in a completely new environment.

programme.title: I Went To Cristiano Ronaldo's House!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed heads to Marrakech to visit Cristiano Ronaldo’s hotel and experience a piece of his idol’s world up close. From exploring the luxury and design to reacting in real time to everything Ronaldo-inspired, Speed brings his signature excitement and energy to the moment. Blending fandom, curiosity, and chaos, the episode captures what it’s like for Speed to step into a space connected to one of his biggest inspirations.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Meets Tony LC SIGN
programme.desc: IShowSpeed meets Tony LC Sign, one of China’s most recognizable internet personalities, for a unique cultural crossover. As the two connect, explore, and interact, the encounter creates a blend of humor, unexpected moments, and genuine cultural exchange. Combining Speed’s signature energy with Tony LC Sign’s larger-than-life presence, the episode captures an unforgettable meeting between two internet worlds.

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In Morocco!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Morocco for the first time, stepping into a vibrant mix of culture, history, and energy. From navigating busy markets and city streets to experiencing local traditions and everyday life, Speed immerses himself in everything Morocco has to offer. Blending curiosity, chaos, and real-time reactions, the episode captures an unfiltered journey through one of North Africa’s most dynamic destinations.

programme.title: iShowSpeed & Zac Wang Recreate Karate Kid Scenes!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed teams up with Zac Wang to recreate some of the most iconic scenes from The Karate Kid while exploring the world of martial arts in China. From legendary training exercises to cinematic recreations inspired by the classic film, the duo puts their skills, discipline, and determination to the test. From taking in the incredible views to reacting to the scale and significance of the monument, Speed immerses himself in one of China’s greatest wonders. Blending adventure, history, and his signature energy, the episode captures an unforgettable journey along one of humanity’s most remarkable achievements.

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In RWANDA!

programme.title: iShowSpeed Meets DA ZHANG WEI!

Blending celebrity, culture, and Speed’s signature chaos, the episode captures an entertaining meeting between one of the internet’s biggest stars and one of China’s most beloved personalities.

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In Barbados!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Barbados for the first time, experiencing the island’s vibrant culture, beautiful scenery, and unique energy. programme.title: El muñeco vudú
programme.desc: Germán y Jorjáis encuentran un muñeco vudú, asumen que alguien está haciendo brujería en el edificio. Pedro, Cris y Vanesa tienen problemas con el WiFi de su departamento.

programme.title: Síntomas empáticos
programme.desc: Luis descubre que es él (y no Silvia), quien tiene los síntomas del embarazo. Los vecinos encuentran en la calle carteles pegados de: "Se busca a Jorjáis".

programme.title: La hija de Jorjais
programme.desc: Una mujer le pregunta a Germán sobre el paradero de Jorjáis, y él se sorprende al descubrir que ella es su hija. Vanessa cree que tiene la maldición de la soltería.

programme.title: Niño o niña
programme.desc: Luis ya no sabe que hacer con Silvia porque tiene muchos cambios de humor por el embarazo, pero sus vecinos lo convencen de darle una sorpresa que jamás olvidará.

programme.title: Conserje aprendiz
programme.desc: Lorena acepta hacer un casting para interpretar el papel de La Doña. Germán decide enseñarle a Borrego a ser un gran conserje.

programme.title: El perfume
programme.desc: Magdalena se aprovecha de las náuseas que siente Silvia por el embarazo para que Luis le compre todo lo que ella quiere.

programme.title: Apolonio y la víbora
programme.desc: Vanesa lleva una serpiente al edificio y se le escapa. Ahora tiene que recuperarla sin que los vecinos se enteren. Silvia y Luis toman un curso psicoprofiláctico con una chica que resulta ser la ex de Luis.

programme.title: La chapa
programme.desc: Luis descompone la chapa de la reja, quedando él y Silvia afuera y el resto de los vecinos adentro. En lo que reparan la chapa, los vecinos usan a Luis de mandadero.

programme.title: Los tocatimbres
programme.desc: Germán cree que los timbres del edificio están embrujados, pues alguien los hace sonar constantemente. Luis intenta colocar unas repisas en el cuarto del bebé.

programme.title: Arturo más pordiosero
programme.desc: Los López Pérez se hacen pasar por pordioseros para recibir caridad. Pedro lleva varios días sin bañarse y Cris le exige que lo haga.

programme.title: El parto
programme.desc: Silvia comienza el trabajo de parto en el departamento, no hay tiempo para llegar al hospital. Luis recibirá al bebé con la ayuda de los vecinos.

programme.title: Vecinos consejeros
programme.desc: El hijo de Silvia y Luis no para de llorar y ya no saben qué hacer. Los vecinos les aconsejan cómo cuidar al bebé mientras Germán improvisa un gimnasio en el vestíbulo.

programme.title: Mucha luz
programme.desc: Hay fallas de energía eléctrica en algunos de los departamentos y Luis tiene que ir a trabajar al departamento de los López Pérez. Germán se prepara para su examen de admisión a la preparatoria en línea.

programme.title: Ya valió barriga
programme.desc: Un nuevo inquilino llega al departamento, su nombre es: Hipólito Menchaca y tiene un gran parecido con el famoso actor Édgar Vivar. Los vecinos quieren quedar bien con él.

programme.title: La jefa del Rocko
programme.desc: La mamá de Rocko viene a conocer a su nieto Morris y tiene la intención de llevarlo a vivir con ella y darle la vida que se merece. Liz se vuelve representante de Benito y le consigue un papel en una película.

programme.title: Conserjerito inglés
programme.desc: Germán y compañía toman clases de inglés en línea con Silvia. Cuando Miss Silvia reprueba a Germán, este descubre la forma de desquitarse. Rocko tiene problemas de oído y creen que se está quedando sordo.

programme.title: La toalla del mojado 2
programme.desc: Frankie recibe una visita inesperada, la famosa actriz Lyn May, quien lo inspira a que haga la película de La toalla del mojado 2. Pedro se encarga de cuidar a Luisito Jr. para que Luis pueda descansar.

programme.title: La veterinaria de Vanesa
programme.desc: Vanesa por fin cumple el sueño de tener su propia veterinaria y, con ayuda de su novio Fabián, renta el local que está en el edificio. Los López Pérez compran una lavadora nueva y la colocan en el pasillo frente al departamento de Luis.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Attack Of The Screw Worms | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 835 - 12 - 835
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with Caleb Hubbard of the Hubbard Urban Entymology Lab at New Mexico State University and "Bubbly" Doug Duren. Topics discussed: Stay tuned for twice a week MeatEater Podcast drops starting in March; come to the Safari Club International 2026 Convention on Feb. 19th to see Steve and Morgan Potter; a correction on Colorado wolf recovery; sous vide rewarming for frostbite; the ins and outs of the New World screw worm; how all warm blooded critters are potential hosts; being eaten alive; Doug's Sharing the Land organization; and more. The New World Screwworm Threat Survey: https://acesnmsu.az1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eLjo05717Wzz1em The New World Screwworm is a serious pest threat to livestock and wildlife, and New Mexico is taking steps to stay proactive-not reactive. The survey gathers input from ranchers, producers, hunters, land stewards, and community members across New Mexico. We're studying what people know, believe, and need regarding screwworm prevention and response.

On this unique Mexican adventure, Steve finds exciting action for gobbling toms. With locally made charcoal at his disposal, he'll grill up a big, brined, delicious bird.

The duo prepares dusky grouse jalape√±o poppers and grouse fettuccine with a white wine and cream sauce.

programme.title: MeatEater - Meet the Meateaters: Montana Crew Muley Part 1
programme.desc: The goal on MeatEater has always been to make viewers feel like they're on a hunt with Steven Rinella, but on this two-part episode Rinella grants his viewers an all-access pass to see just how the MeatEater crew works together to make the show. Strap-in for some behind-the-scenes action.

On a float trip for mule deer through the rugged Missouri Breaks, this is as adventurous of a first hunt as anyone could hope for, and Steve's special guests are in for a memorable experience and delicious wild game field cooking in some gorgeous country.

programme.title: MeatEater - First Timers: Montana Mule Deer Part 2

programme.title: MeatEater - The Wide Open: New Mexico Antelope
programme.desc: Steven Rinella and friend Cody Lujan head to Northeastern New Mexico to hunt pronghorn antelope, the fastest big game animal in the United States. In the wide open desert plains, Steve will have to work hard to stalk within range of a mature buck. The payoff will be antelope loin topped with local New Mexico chiles.

programme.title: MeatEater - Primal Cuts: Bone-in Cooking Special
programme.desc: In this cooking special, Steven Rinella shows his fans some of his favorite preparations for big, bone-in cuts of red meat. Interspersed with highlights from his recent caribou, buffalo, and mule deer hunts, the show features recipes that utilize some of the most underappreciated parts of big game animals. This episode is an attractive and delicious tribute to Steve's gun-to-table ethic.

programme.title: MeatEater - El Venado Blanco: Mexico Coues Deer
programme.desc: Steven Rinella returns to his favorite hunting grounds of Sonora, Mexico to hunt for a Coues deer buck during the peak rutting season. Steve sets up camp and spends days glassing mountains and canyons for these elusive, wary desert whitetails. Meanwhile, his hunting partner, Remi Warren, attempts the difficult task of stalking one with a bow. To cap off the hunt, Steve cooks a batch of venison ribs braised in a Dutch oven buried beneath hot coals.

programme.title: MeatEater - Clash of the Titans: Northern California Pig & Deer
programme.desc: In this episode, Steven Rinella joins forces with fellow hunter and wild game chef Hank Shaw in the hills of Central California to go after Columbia blacktail deer, wild pigs, and a handful of small game species that are in season. The end result is a culinary smorgasbord of epic proportions.

programme.title: MeatEater - Sea Bear: Alaska Spring Bear and Seafood
programme.desc: Steve ventures out to his hunting and fishing shack on a remote coastline of southeast Alaska's Prince of Wales Island. While hunting bears from a skiff and a canoe, Steve gathers a variety of prime seafood and makes a discovery about his own motivations as a bear hunter.

programme.title: MeatEater - Full Boar: Whole Hog Cooking Special
programme.desc: Steven Rinella breaks down an entire boar and shares some of his favorite recipes in this Cooking Special. Matt Weingarter helps steve make head cheese, pork skin cracklins, smoked pork butt, and a tied-roast boned-out ham. Each dish requires thoughtful butchering, processing, and cooking to execute to perfection.

programme.title: This F*cking Guy (Jake Paul: Everything You Didn't Know About His Sh*tty Past)
programme.desc: In our 45th episode of This F*cking Guy, Erin Ryan and Nina Parker break down the ball-tasering, clout-chasing manchild, Jake Paul. From his Vine and YouTube "prank" beginnings, to running a content sweatshop called Team 10, to scamming children via crypto pump-and-dumps and sham online "universities," to gentrifying Puerto Rico and cozying up to Trump, to finally getting his jaw broken in two places by Anthony Joshua...this may just be our most exhaustingly f*ckboy yet!

programme.title: What a Day (Amending The Constitution For The 21st Century)
programme.desc:
President Donald Trump is obsessed with the past. Last night, Trump gave a primetime address about his favorite subject: the 2020 election, which he did not win. But as we have just celebrated America’s 250th birthday, many of us are thinking a lot about the past – and what our history has to do with the future of our country. Heather Cox Richardson is a history professor at Boston College and the author of the Substack “Letters from an American.” We talked about America’s past, what historical moments remind her most of right now, and why – despite everything – she’s hopeful about the future.
And in headlines, Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin gives a White House briefing doubling down on Trump’s election claims, the US expands its attacks in what feels like the never-ending war against Iran, and federal officials have identified a source of the outbreak of the diarrhea-causing parasite cyclospora.

programme.desc: Talk Show and Variety

programme.title: What a Day (Reining In The Congressional Culture of Harassment)
programme.desc:
The fact that the US Congress is absolutely rotten with creeps is one of the worst-kept secrets in Washington. From former Representatives like California Democrat Eric Swalwell and Texas Republican Tony Gonzales, to sitting lawmakers like North Carolina Republican Representative Chuck Edwards – it turns out sexual misconduct is bipartisan, and so is the pushback. A bipartisan effort fronted by Florida Republican Kat Cammack and New Mexico Democrat Teresa Leger Fernandez aims to rein in the frathouse behavior of their colleagues. To discuss what’s on the table, we called up Grace Panetta, political reporter with The 19th.
And in headlines, Trump blames vandals for ruining a patch of grass on the National Mall, Attorney General Todd Blanche refused to pledge that he’ll operate independently from the White House, and the Supreme Court rejected another request to throw out a jury’s 2023 finding that Trump sexually abused writer E. Jean Carroll and later defamed her.

programme.title: Assembly Required with Stacey Abrams (Is the South the Future of Democratic Politics?)
programme.desc: Is the South the new epicenter of American politics? National Association of Black Journalists President, The 19th Editor-at-Large, and host of Crooked’s new podcast Long Play, Errin Haines sits down with Stacey to unpack why the South is so fundamentally misunderstood and why expanding our imagination of what the region looks like could be key to winning Democratic elections. They also discuss the NABJ “Thumbs-Down Awards,” the Trump administration’s attacks on DEI, and the growing threat of media censorship

programme.title: Strict Scrutiny (All the President’s Henchmen)
programme.desc: Kate is joined by Liz Oyer, former DOJ pardon attorney and federal public defender, to tick through last week’s news. Among the items covered: Todd Blanche’s swearing-in by lackey Emil Bove, the latest attempt by the administration to expand executive privilege, the renewed vendetta against the Fed’s Lisa Cook, and John Roberts’ Substack debut…That’s right, the Chief is out here postin’. Then, a conversation with Julia Angwin and Ami Fields-Meyer about their new book, On Courage: How to Be a Dissident in an Age of Fear. Check out Liz’s podcast, Is This Really Legal?.

programme.title: Pod Save America (Printer? I Hardly Know Her!)
programme.desc: Jon Ossoff attacks Trump for sidestepping his duties to "travel with Natalie," the White House aide known as Trump's "Human Printer," who has a suspiciously close relationship to the president. Jon, Tommy, and Lovett discuss the new line of attack and the president's response, the end of the 60-day cease-fire agreement with Iran, Trump's decision to scale back joint military exercises with South Korea, and his reaction to the horrible conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln. Then, they check in on the fight to take back the Senate, Ken Paxton stealing a $1,000 pen, Mary Peltola rejecting Kamala Harris's endorsement, and a new poll in Michigan that has Abdul El-Sayed down four points to Mike Rogers. Then, Brian Poindexter, a union ironworker, talks to Tommy about his campaign to unseat disgraced congressman Max Miller of Ohio.

programme.title: Spicy Red Food & Korean BBQ Mukbang ASMR
programme.desc: Join Kika Kim for a fiery and flavorful ASMR mukbang adventure! First, experience the heat with an all red and spicy feast of noodles, snacks, strawberries, jelly, and more surprises. Then, savor the rich taste of Korean cuisine, featuring delicious beef bulgogi barbecue and other traditional dishes. Relax, enjoy, and treat yourself to your favorite food while watching this tasty episode!

programme.title: Korean Restaurant Feast & Purple Desserts Mukbang ASMR
programme.desc: Join us for a unique ASMR mukbang episode! First, Kika Kim and Chanderland from XO Team visit an authentic Korean restaurant to enjoy spicy chicken, samgyeopsal, sushi, rice, and more. Then, explore a sweet and colorful purple food mukbang featuring chocolates, noodles, and snacks. Relax and savor every tasty moment of this special double-feature experience!

Then, enjoy a special car picnic with XO Team’s Alisha & Elsarca, sharing sweets, fruits, sushi rolls, and sandwiches. Experience the satisfying sounds and vibrant treats in this unique and delicious episode!

programme.title: GUESS THE IMPOSTER
programme.desc: Could you pick a celebrity out of a crowd if you'd never seen them before? AMP brings in strangers who've never heard of them and challenges the guys to impersonate each other — convincing total strangers they are who they claim to be.

programme.title: GUESS THE FELON
programme.desc: Five actors, one real ex-felon. AMP has to figure out who's actually done time. After rounds of questions, the guys whittle down the contestants until they land on who they believe is the true felon.

programme.title: LAST TO LEAVE THE YACHT
programme.desc: How long would you stay on a yacht if the last one left gets to keep it? That's the challenge AMP takes on, competing through a series of boat-themed games to see who wants it most.

programme.title: DIRTY JOBS
programme.desc: AMP puts the age-old debate to rest — is streaming actually harder than a 9 to 5? The guys go to work and compete through real challenges to find the answer.

programme.title: DRIVER'S ED
programme.desc: The guys become driving coaches. AMP splits into 3 teams of two, each tasked with taking their student driver through the full AMP driving checklist.

programme.title: ESCAPE OR DIE
programme.desc: Duke, Agent, and Chris get thrown into a real-life Zombie simulator based on Resident Evil, sent into an abandoned building to rescue Kai Cenat from the evil doctor Gideon.

programme.title: EXTREME HIDE AND SEEK
programme.desc: BREAKING NEWS — AMP has been kidnapped and brought to a remote facility. The guys have to hide from their captors and escape with their lives in this extreme IRL hide and seek challenge.

programme.title: PLAYGROUND GAMES
programme.desc: AMP brings back classic childhood games with an IRL twist. From floor is lava to musical chairs, the guys go head-to-head to see who is the ultimate playground champion.

programme.title: HIBACHI WARS
programme.desc: The boys hit the hibachi grill, trained by real Master Hibachi Chefs on everything they need to make a 5-star meal. Then they compete head-to-head to see which team cooks it better.

programme.title: WOULD YOU RATHER IRL
programme.desc: Would you rather get slapped in the face or eat a live bug? AMP takes Would You Rather to the next level, competing through real challenges where every choice has real consequences.

programme.title: TRY NOT TO LAUGH: FACE OFF
programme.desc: Time for another Try Not To Laugh challenge. The guys compete face to face trying to make each other crack. Each round brings a new prompt — find out who can hold their laugh the longest.

programme.title: STREET BASKETBALL DRAFT
programme.desc: The guys hit the streets in two teams with only $500 to build the best basketball squad they can find. The catch — every player has to come from off the street.

programme.title: RDC vs AMP BASEBALL
programme.desc: AMP and RDC meet up again for another group challenge. This time they take the field in a classic game of backyard baseball, going head to head to prove who is the more athletic crew.

programme.title: MMA BASKETBALL
programme.desc: MMA meets Basketball — and the result is exactly what you'd expect. AMP goes head-to-head in an extreme combination sport where there are no fouls and being physical is not just allowed, it's encouraged.

programme.title: MARIO KART IRL
programme.desc: In the world of Mario Kart, one wrong turn flips everything. AMP suits up in real karts and costumes to experience the harsh realities of that world in a full IRL race.

programme.title: MARIO KART IRL 2
programme.desc: AMP is back with another IRL Mario Kart challenge. This time the karts are fully modded to imitate real in-game power-ups, making the races even more unpredictable than before.
